name: Apito Final
description: Professional live-sports broadcast platform: multi-sport scorekeeping, custom branded themes, and a unified web and desktop operator dashboard with real-time OBS overlays.
longDescription: Apito Final is a live-sports streaming platform for broadcast operators who need dependable control across multiple disciplines. Operators manage fixtures from a web or desktop dashboard (Rust/Tauri + React) while lightweight overlay scenes render in OBS with sub-second synchronisation. Each deployment supports custom themes: colours, typography, sponsor placement, and sport-specific layouts: without rebuilding the core product. Team and competition metadata is cached in MongoDB for fast match-day workflows; sensitive venue configuration is encrypted locally and administrative actions are PIN-protected. Verified public releases distribute desktop builds and official asset bundles with integrity checks. Automated CI covers Windows and Linux with unit and integration tests across the control desk and overlay runtime.
features: Multi-sport live streaming with sport-aware scorekeeping and overlay scenes
Custom theme system for branded broadcasts: colours, layouts, and sponsor zones
Unified web and desktop operator dashboard with OBS-ready overlay consumers
Real-time synchronisation between control desk and broadcast overlays
MongoDB-backed team and competition cache with export paths for broadcast tools
Encrypted local configuration, PIN-gated admin actions, and verified release updates
highlights: One platform spanning multiple sports, custom themes, and venue-ready packaging
Memory-safe Rust desktop core with a responsive web and desktop operator experience
Production-grade match-day reliability through signed releases and automated test coverage
challenges: Multi-sport broadcast tooling must stay consistent when overlays reload, themes change, and venue networks fluctuate.
solutions: Sport-agnostic real-time contracts, theme-driven overlay composition, local persistence, encrypted configuration, and automated tests across dashboard and overlay surfaces.
security: Encrypted storage for sensitive local configuration
PIN protection for destructive administrative actions
Least-privilege database access for venue deployments
